purpose: Binds the corrected frozen full Week 4 course specification to exactly one approved private scoped-image snapshot for local human question-level gold review. This binding is not a model-run authorization.
purpose_zh: 将范围纠正后的 Week 4 全题课程规范绑定到唯一一份已批准的私有 scope 图片快照，仅供本地人工逐题 gold 复核使用；本文件不授权模型运行。
